turns.assistantText:
Incident remains open at SEV2.

- Identified checkout retry behavior in API 2.4.0 as the initiating regression: retries increased from 2 to 6 with neither jitter nor a retry budget, saturating the connection pool.
- Acknowledged the incident and published customer-facing status updates.
- Rolled back API 2.4.0 to 2.3.9 (no migration risk).
- The rollback had reduced available serving capacity during transition, so I scaled API to 10 replicas and initiated the staged retry fix roll-forward.
- Capped `/checkout` at 90 req/s to drain the queue and protect the backend; excess checkout requests are currently rejected.

Browsing remains healthy. Checkout errors have declined from roughly 88% after the rollback transition to roughly 67%, but remain above acceptable levels due to the active admission cap and recovery capacity. Continuing monitoring is required before lifting the cap or declaring recovery.
